Deep Research Prompt Builder

Craft a deep-research commission prompt.
SKILL · RUNS AUTOMATICALLY WHEN IT APPLIES

What it does

Builds a deep-research commission prompt for the STA knowledge base - frontmatter, source tiering, and a per-module breakdown - and returns a one-click kickoff prompt to start the research.

When to use it

You want to commission new KB research modules on a topic.

How to trigger it

"craft a deep research prompt"

"build a research commission"

"new research prompt"

Requirements

What this skill needs in order to run. Added 2026-08-20.

Skills - None.

Connectors / MCP servers - None.

Folder access - Write access to the Deep Research project folder, specifically its _prompts/ subfolder.

KB modules / context files - None.

Repos - None.

If something is missing - There is a folder-access gate before any intake work, and it checks two ways before declaring failure - the mounted filesystem, then the device bridge. That second check exists because on 2026-08-05 the first check returned nothing while the folder was in fact reachable, which produced a wrong failure. Only if both fail does the skill stop, and it hands you a paste-ready block instead. A single negative result is not evidence the folder is unreachable.
